items.statement: 无水第一次 PT/ET 均轻度有利
items.expected: Actual physically comparable calculations support mildly favorable dry first PT and first ET endpoints, providing thermodynamic support for both starting routes. No exact numerical-window pass is required for this independent qualitative finding. Endpoints alone do not establish a unique sequence or kinetic preference.

items.statement: 无水第二次 PT 比 ET 少吸能
items.expected: Actual calculations from the same I support uphill dry second PT and ET endpoints with PT less endergonic than ET. Assess the supported signs and relative ordering independently from numerical magnitude windows; do not relabel these endpoint energies as activation barriers.

items.statement: 第一氢转移中间物种的化学解释
items.expected: Actual structures/electronic-state evidence establish the compositionally consistent first hydrogen-transfer intermediate I as ground-state HPQ radical plus PyOH radical and connect it to the analyzed PT/ET endpoints with conserved atoms, charge and hydrogen inventory. A drawing or copied species names alone is insufficient; no new transition-state or unique kinetic pathway calculation is required.
